errors.meaning: The placement description does not match the deterministic grammar.
The description names no known InkLang site or zone.
The requested side is incompatible with the named site.
The requested aspect is not allowed for the named site.
The requested level is invalid or cannot refine the named site.
The relation is malformed or its metric offset is outside the supported range.
A sided site was requested without choosing left or right.
A composite zone names several valid leaf-site locations.
The relation has more than one geometrically meaningful direction or target.
The caller named no supported canonical body.
The named body has no available region atlas.
The loaded atlas belongs to a different body.
The atlas and loaded canonical rest surface have different digests.
The intent, lexicon, atlas, or resolver versions are incompatible.
The atlas has no faces or valid candidate for the requested region.
A relative surface walk cannot reach the requested offset on tattooable connected skin.
The resolved face or barycentric coordinates are invalid.
Description, intent, site, anchor, or reverse description disagree.
